batch_node.name: Samsite users seed v0.1.0
batch_node.description: Seeds the human actors in the samsite story as computing_core `user` nodes: Readers (the site's audience), george (the operator reproducing and modeling the system in TAP), and Sam (Sam Aydlette, author of the original samaydlette.com system). The `user` type carries no per-model tags field, so the landing search reaches these via an explicit MATCH (u:computing_core__user) rather than the Project=samsite tag scan. Edges/roles and projection placement are intentionally not seeded here — the visualization session decides where these sit on the projection.
